title: Auntie Zhang Finds “Love in Old Age”
synopsis: Remarrying in old age is becoming more commonly accepted in China. Read about Auntie Zhang’s experience with remarrying!

fullText.simplified:
张大妈的“黄昏恋”

    据不完全统计，中国60岁及以上的老年人口达2.49亿之多，占总人口的17.9%。都说：“少年夫妻老来伴”。但是现实生活中，因为疾病、家庭、情感等原因，很多夫妻并不能相伴到老。
    独居老人们随着年纪的增加，内心的不安全感也会不断加深。而这种不安全感不是钱多和儿女孝顺就能解决的。说白了就是他们也需要有个伴儿，这样会让他们觉得不那么孤单。但是以前，老年人再婚是个大问题，第一个站出来反对的就是他们的子女。毕竟再婚关系到财产、养老、房子等一系列问题，解决不好，出现的问题会更多。再加上传统观念的影响，所以老年人再婚或者想找另一半的想法并不被认可。
    随着社会的发展和进步，越来越多的人开始接受这件事情了。他们认为只要提前解决好再婚后的问题，老年人再婚利大于弊。
    张大妈就是众多独居老人中的一个。她老伴儿已经去世十多年了，69岁的张大妈，儿女都在外地工作。虽然她退休金不少，吃喝不愁，但是随着年龄的增长，孤独感越来越强了。儿女们工作都忙，一年到头回不了几次家。张大妈希望能再找个老伴儿，这样一来，万一有个头疼脑热什么的可以互相照顾。
    最近，有人给张大妈介绍了一个老头儿——刘大爷。刘大爷71岁，老伴儿去世三年了，子女都在国外，身体健康，喜欢旅游、唱歌和运动。张大妈跟刘大爷见了几次面，觉得他人很不错。但是她怕孩子们反对，不知道怎么跟孩子们说。她的老姐妹王阿姨给她出了个主意，让她趁五一假期孩子们都回来了的时间约刘大爷吃个饭，看看孩子们的反应。
    很快就到了五一假期，孩子们都回来了。张大妈特意做了一大桌子菜，她的儿子和女儿看到后很吃惊。女儿说：“妈妈，您这可是头一次做这么多好吃的，以前我和哥哥回家，您可没做过这么多菜。您是不是有什么事啊？”张大妈说：“我有个老朋友一直想吃我做的菜，这不你们也回来了吗，顺便请他来家里吃个饭。”女儿一听，看了一眼哥哥说：“我猜，是个男的吧？”
    正说着，门铃响了，张大妈打开了门，跟孩子们介绍了刘大爷，然后他们开始吃饭。饭桌上，刘大爷跟孩子们聊得很开心。别看刘大爷岁数不小了，可是他非常喜欢新鲜事物，和年轻人有很多共同话题。
    女儿跟张大妈说：“妈妈，你这个朋友不错，我喜欢。”听完女儿的话，张大妈的心放下了一半，她认真地跟孩子们说：“儿子、闺女，如果我告诉你们我想跟刘叔叔结婚，你们会同意吗？”
    孩子们听了张大妈的话，先是沉默了几分钟，然后女儿说：“我需要跟哥哥商量一下。”说完她拉着哥哥进了卧室。
    孩子们离开的这段时间是张大妈和刘大爷最紧张的时间。过了大概十分钟，孩子们出来了，他们走到张大妈身边说：“妈妈，刘叔叔，我们同意。刘叔叔人不错，我们工作忙不能常常回家，有刘叔叔照顾您，我们放心。”然后又走到刘大爷旁边说：“刘叔叔，我妈妈有退休金，有医保，我们也都工作挣钱了，生活上没有负担。听妈妈说您的孩子都在国外，将来您跟我妈妈结婚了，我们就是您的儿子和女儿，我们会像照顾妈妈一样照顾您的。不过，您可一定要对妈妈好哦！”
    听了孩子们的话，张大妈和刘大爷哈哈大笑。刘大爷说：“放心吧，孩子们，我和你妈会很幸福的。老了找个合适的伴儿不容易，我会好好珍惜的。”
fullText.traditional:
張大媽的“黃昏戀”

    據不完全統計，中國60歲及以上的老年人口達2.49億之多，占總人口的17.9%。都說：“少年夫妻老來伴”。但是現實生活中，因為疾病、家庭、情感等原因，很多夫妻並不能相伴到老。
    獨居老人們隨著年紀的增加，內心的不安全感也會不斷加深。而這種不安全感不是錢多和兒女孝順就能解決的。說白了就是他們也需要有個伴兒，這樣會讓他們覺得不那麼孤單。但是以前，老年人再婚是個大問題，第一個站出來反對的就是他們的子女。畢竟再婚關係到財產、養老、房子等一系列問題，解決不好，出現的問題會更多。再加上傳統觀念的影響，所以老年人再婚或者想找另一半的想法並不被認可。
    隨著社會的發展和進步，越來越多的人開始接受這件事情了。他們認為只要提前解決好再婚後的問題，老年人再婚利大於弊。
    張大媽就是眾多獨居老人中的一個。她老伴兒已經去世十多年了，69歲的張大媽，兒女都在外地工作。雖然她退休金不少，吃喝不愁，但是隨著年齡的增長，孤獨感越來越強了。兒女們工作都忙，一年到頭回不了幾次家。張大媽希望能再找個老伴兒，這樣一來，萬一有個頭疼腦熱甚麼的可以互相照顧。
    最近，有人給張大媽介紹了一個老頭兒——劉大爺。劉大爺71歲，老伴兒去世三年了，子女都在國外，身體健康，喜歡旅遊、唱歌和運動。張大媽跟劉大爺見了幾次面，覺得他人很不錯。但是她怕孩子們反對，不知道怎麼跟孩子們說。她的老姐妹王阿姨給她出了個主意，讓她趁五一假期孩子們都回來了的時間約劉大爺吃個飯，看看孩子們的反應。
    很快就到了五一假期，孩子們都回來了。張大媽特意做了一大桌子菜，她的兒子和女兒看到後很吃驚。女兒說：“媽媽，您這可是頭一次做這麼多好吃的，以前我和哥哥回家，您可沒做過這麼多菜。您是不是有什麼事啊？”張大媽說：“我有個老朋友一直想吃我做的菜，這不你們也回來了嗎，順便請他來家裡吃個飯。”女兒一聽，看了一眼哥哥說：“我猜，是個男的吧？”
    正說著，門鈴響了，張大媽打開了門，跟孩子們介紹了劉大爺，然後他們開始吃飯。飯桌上，劉大爺跟孩子們聊得很開心。別看劉大爺歲數不小了，可是他非常喜歡新鮮事物，和年輕人有很多共同話題。
    女兒跟張大媽說：“媽媽，你這個朋友不錯，我喜歡。”聽完女兒的話，張大媽的心放下了一半，她認真地跟孩子們說：“兒子、閨女，如果我告訴你們我想跟劉叔叔結婚，你們會同意嗎？”
    孩子們聽了張大媽的話，先是沉默了幾分鐘，然後女兒說：“我需要跟哥哥商量一下。”說完她拉著哥哥進了臥室。
    孩子們離開的這段時間是張大媽和劉大爺最緊張的時間。過了大概十分鐘，孩子們出來了，他們走到張大媽身邊說：“媽媽，劉叔叔，我們同意。劉叔叔人不錯，我們工作忙不能常常回家，有劉叔叔照顧您，我們放心。”然後又走到劉大爺旁邊說：“劉叔叔，我媽媽有退休金，有醫保，我們也都工作掙錢了，生活上沒有負擔。聽媽媽說您的孩子都在國外，將來您跟我媽媽結婚了，我們就是您的兒子和女兒，我們會像照顧媽媽一樣照顧您的。不過，您可一定要對媽媽好哦！”
    聽了孩子們的話，張大媽和劉大爺哈哈大笑。劉大爺說：“放心吧，孩子們，我和你媽會很幸福的。老了找個合適的伴兒不容易，我會好好珍惜的。”

sentences.traditional: 約劉大爺吃個飯，看看孩子們的反應。
sentences.pinyin: yuē liú dà ye chī ge fàn kàn kan hái zi men de fǎn yìng
sentences.english: The idea was for her to take advantage of the May Day holiday when the children would be home, ..
.. ask Uncle Liu to dinner with them, and see how the children react.

sentences.simplified: 很快就到了五一假期，孩子们都回来了。
sentences.traditional: 很快就到了五一假期，孩子們都回來了。
sentences.pinyin: hěn kuài jiù dào le wǔ yī jià qī hái zi men dōu huí lái le

sentences.simplified: 张大妈特意做了一大桌子菜，
sentences.traditional: 張大媽特意做了一大桌子菜，
sentences.pinyin: zhāng dà mā tè yì zuò le yí dà zhuō zi cài
sentences.english: The May Day holiday soon came, and the children all came home.

sentences.simplified: 她的儿子和女儿看到后很吃惊。
sentences.traditional: 她的兒子和女兒看到後很吃驚。
sentences.pinyin: tā de ér zi hé nǚ ér kàn dào hòu hěn chī jīng
sentences.english: Auntie Zhang specially cooked a whole table of dishes just for this occasion.

sentences.simplified: 女儿说：“妈妈，您这可是头一次做这么多好吃的，
sentences.traditional: 女兒說：“媽媽，您這可是頭一次做這麼多好吃的，
sentences.pinyin: nǚ ér shuō mā ma nín zhè kě shì tóu yí cì zuò zhè me duō hǎo chī de
sentences.english: Her son and daughter were very surprised upon seeing this.

sentences.simplified: 以前我和哥哥回家，您可没做过这么多菜。您是不是有什么事啊？”
sentences.traditional: 以前我和哥哥回家，您可沒做過這麼多菜。您是不是有什麼事啊？”
sentences.pinyin: yǐ qián wǒ hé gē ge huí jiā nín kě méi zuò guò zhè me duō cài nín shì bú shì yǒu shén me shì a
sentences.english: Her daughter said, “Mom, this is the first time you’ve cooked this much delicious food.

sentences.simplified: 张大妈说：“我有个老朋友一直想吃我做的菜，
sentences.traditional: 張大媽說：“我有個老朋友一直想吃我做的菜，
sentences.pinyin: zhāng dà mā shuō wǒ yǒu ge lǎo péng you yì zhí xiǎng chī wǒ zuò de cài
sentences.english: When my older brother and I used to come home, you certainly didn’t cook this many dishes. Is something going on?”

sentences.simplified: 这不你们也回来了吗，顺便请他来家里吃个饭。”
sentences.traditional: 這不你們也回來了嗎，順便請他來家裡吃個飯。”
sentences.pinyin: zhè bu nǐ men yě huí lái le ma shùn biàn qǐng tā lái jiā lǐ chī ge fàn
sentences.english: Auntie Zhang said, “I have an old friend who has been wanting to taste my cooking.

sentences.simplified: 女儿一听，看了一眼哥哥说：“我猜，是个男的吧？”
sentences.traditional: 女兒一聽，看了一眼哥哥說：“我猜，是個男的吧？”
sentences.pinyin: nǚ ér yì tīng kàn le yì yǎn gē ge shuō wǒ cāi shì ge nán de ba
sentences.english: Now that you all are back, I wanted to invite him over for dinner.”
When her daughter heard this, she looked over at her older brother and said, “Let me guess, it’s a man?”

sentences.simplified: 正说着，门铃响了，
sentences.traditional: 正說著，門鈴響了，
sentences.pinyin: zhèng shuō zhe mén líng xiǎng le

sentences.simplified: 张大妈打开了门，跟孩子们介绍了刘大爷，然后他们开始吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 張大媽打開了門，跟孩子們介紹了劉大爺，然後他們開始吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: zhāng dà mā dǎ kāi le mén gēn hái zi men jiè shào le liú dà ye rán hòu tā men kāi shǐ chī fàn
sentences.english: Just as they were speaking, the doorbell rang.

sentences.simplified: 饭桌上，刘大爷跟孩子们聊得很开心。
sentences.traditional: 飯桌上，劉大爺跟孩子們聊得很開心。
sentences.pinyin: fàn zhuō shang liú dà ye gēn hái zi men liáo de hěn kāi xīn
sentences.english: Auntie Zhang opened the door and introduced Uncle Liu to the children. Then, they started eating.

sentences.simplified: 别看刘大爷岁数不小了，可是他非常喜欢新鲜事物，和年轻人有很多共同话题。
sentences.traditional: 別看劉大爺歲數不小了，可是他非常喜歡新鮮事物，和年輕人有很多共同話題。
sentences.pinyin: bié kàn liú dà ye suì shu bù xiǎo le kě shì tā fēi cháng xǐ huan xīn xiān shì wù hé nián qīng rén yǒu hěn duō gòng tóng huà tí
sentences.english: At the dinner table, Uncle Liu and the children had a great time chatting.
Despite Uncle Liu’s age, he is very fond of new things and has a lot of things in common with young people.

sentences.simplified: 女儿跟张大妈说：“妈妈，你这个朋友不错，我喜欢。”
sentences.traditional: 女兒跟張大媽說：“媽媽，你這個朋友不錯，我喜歡。”
sentences.pinyin: nǚ ér gēn zhāng dà mā shuō mā ma nǐ zhè ge péng you bú cuò wǒ xǐ huan

sentences.simplified: 听完女儿的话，张大妈的心放下了一半，
sentences.traditional: 聽完女兒的話，張大媽的心放下了一半，
sentences.pinyin: tīng wán nǚ ér de huà zhāng dà mā de xīn fàng xià le yí bàn
sentences.english: Auntie Zhang’s daughter said to her, “Mom, this friend of yours is great. I like him.”

sentences.simplified: 她认真地跟孩子们说：“儿子、闺女，如果我告诉你们我想跟刘叔叔结婚，你们会同意吗？”
sentences.traditional: 她認真地跟孩子們說：“兒子、閨女，如果我告訴你們我想跟劉叔叔結婚，你們會同意嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: tā rèn zhēn de gēn hái zi men shuō ér zi guī nǚ rú guǒ wǒ gào su nǐ men wǒ xiǎng gēn liú shū shu jié hūn nǐ men huì tóng yì ma
sentences.english: After hearing her daughter say this, half of Auntie Zhang’s worries were gone.
She earnestly said to her children, “Son, Daughter, if I told you I wanted to marry Uncle Liu, would you agree to this?”

sentences.simplified: 孩子们听了张大妈的话，先是沉默了几分钟，
sentences.traditional: 孩子們聽了張大媽的話，先是沉默了幾分鐘，
sentences.pinyin: hái zi men tīng le zhāng dà mā de huà xiān shì chén mò le jǐ fēn zhōng

sentences.simplified: 然后女儿说：“我需要跟哥哥商量一下。”
sentences.traditional: 然後女兒說：“我需要跟哥哥商量一下。”
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu nǚ ér shuō wǒ xū yào gēn gē ge shāng liang yí xià
sentences.english: The children heard Auntie Zhang’s words and were quiet for a few minutes.

sentences.simplified: 说完她拉着哥哥进了卧室。
sentences.traditional: 說完她拉著哥哥進了臥室。
sentences.pinyin: shuō wán tā lā zhe gē ge jìn le wò shì
sentences.english: Then, her daughter said, “I need to discuss this with my older brother.”
After speaking, she pulled her older brother into the bedroom.

sentences.simplified: 孩子们离开的这段时间是张大妈和刘大爷最紧张的时间。
sentences.traditional: 孩子們離開的這段時間是張大媽和劉大爺最緊張的時間。
sentences.pinyin: hái zi men lí kāi de zhè duàn shí jiān shì zhāng dà mā hé liú dà ye zuì jǐn zhāng de shí jiān

sentences.simplified: 过了大概十分钟，孩子们出来了，他们走到张大妈身边说：
sentences.traditional: 過了大概十分鐘，孩子們出來了，他們走到張大媽身邊說：
sentences.pinyin: guò le dà gài shí fēn zhōng hái zi men chū lái le tā men zǒu dào zhāng dà mā shēn biān shuō
sentences.english: This time while the children were away was the most nervous time for Auntie Zhang and Uncle Liu.

sentences.simplified: “妈妈，刘叔叔，我们同意。刘叔叔人不错，
sentences.traditional: “媽媽，劉叔叔，我們同意。劉叔叔人不錯，
sentences.pinyin: mā ma liú shū shu wǒ men tóng yì liú shū shu rén bú cuò
sentences.english: After around 10 minutes, the children came out, walked over to Auntie Zhang’s side, and said, ..

sentences.simplified: 我们工作忙不能常常回家，有刘叔叔照顾您，我们放心。”
sentences.traditional: 我們工作忙不能常常回家，有劉叔叔照顧您，我們放心。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men gōng zuò máng bù néng cháng cháng huí jiā yǒu liú shū shu zhào gù nín wǒ men fàng xīn
sentences.english: .. “Mom, Uncle Liu, we agree. Uncle Liu is a good person.

sentences.simplified: 然后又走到刘大爷旁边说：
sentences.traditional: 然後又走到劉大爺旁邊說：
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu yòu zǒu dào liú dà ye páng biān shuō
sentences.english: We are busy with work and cannot come home often, so if you have Uncle Liu taking care of you, that would put us at ease.”

sentences.simplified: “刘叔叔，我妈妈有退休金，有医保，我们也都工作挣钱了，
sentences.traditional: “劉叔叔，我媽媽有退休金，有醫保，我們也都工作掙錢了，
sentences.pinyin: liú shū shu wǒ mā ma yǒu tuì xiū jīn yǒu yī bǎo wǒ men yě dōu gōng zuò zhèng qián le
sentences.english: Then, they walked to Uncle Liu’s side and said, ..

sentences.simplified: 生活上没有负担。听妈妈说您的孩子都在国外，
sentences.traditional: 生活上沒有負擔。聽媽媽說您的孩子都在國外，
sentences.pinyin: shēng huó shang méi yǒu fù dān tīng mā ma shuō nín de hái zi dōu zài guó wài
sentences.english: .. ”Uncle Liu, my mom has a retirement pension and health insurance, and we are both working and earning money.

sentences.simplified: 将来您跟我妈妈结婚了，我们就是您的儿子和女儿，
sentences.traditional: 將來您跟我媽媽結婚了，我們就是您的兒子和女兒，
sentences.pinyin: jiāng lái nín gēn wǒ mā ma jié hūn le wǒ men jiù shì nín de ér zi hé nǚ ér
sentences.english: She won’t be a burden. I heard my mom say that your children are all overseas.

sentences.simplified: 我们会像照顾妈妈一样照顾您的。不过，您可一定要对妈妈好哦！”
sentences.traditional: 我們會像照顧媽媽一樣照顧您的。不過，您可一定要對媽媽好哦！”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men huì xiàng zhào gù mā ma yí yàng zhào gù nín de bú guò nín kě yí dìng yào duì mā ma hǎo o
sentences.english: So, in the future, after you and my mom get married, we will be your son and daughter.
We will take care of you just like we take care of our mom. But, you must be good to our mom!”

sentences.simplified: 听了孩子们的话，张大妈和刘大爷哈哈大笑。
sentences.traditional: 聽了孩子們的話，張大媽和劉大爺哈哈大笑。
sentences.pinyin: tīng le hái zi men de huà zhāng dà mā hé liú dà ye hā hā dà xiào

sentences.simplified: 刘大爷说：“放心吧，孩子们，我和你妈会很幸福的。
sentences.traditional: 劉大爺說：“放心吧，孩子們，我和你媽會很幸福的。
sentences.pinyin: liú dà ye shuō fàng xīn ba hái zi men wǒ hé nǐ mā huì hěn xìng fú de
sentences.english: After hearing the children’s words, Auntie Zhang and Uncle Liu laughed out loud.

sentences.simplified: 老了找个合适的伴儿不容易，我会好好珍惜的。”
sentences.traditional: 老了找個合適的伴兒不容易，我會好好珍惜的。”
sentences.pinyin: lǎo le zhǎo ge hé shì de bàn ér bù róng yì wǒ huì hǎo hǎo zhēn xī de
sentences.english: Uncle Liu said, “Don’t worry, children, your mom and I will be happy.

sentence_translations: Auntie Zhang Finds “Love in Old Age”
According to incomplete statistics, China’s elderly population aged 60 and above totals over 249 million.
This accounts for 17.9% of the total population. It is often said: “marriage partners when young and companions in old age”.
But in real life, many couples are unable to grow old together due to issues such as illness, family, and emotions.
As old people who live alone get older, their inner insecurities will continue to deepen.
These insecurities cannot be cured by money or by the devotion of their children.
Put simply, they also need a companion. This way, they won’t feel as lonely.
But in the past, old people remarrying was a big issue. The first to oppose were their children.
After all, marriage affects a whole series of issues such as finances, caring for the elderly, and housing.
If these are not resolved, then many more problems will arise.
Together with the influence of traditional views, ..
.. this has caused people not to accept the idea of old people remarrying or finding a significant other.
With the development and progress of society, more and more people are accepting this idea.
They believe that as long as post-remarriage issues are resolved in advance, the pros of old people remarrying outweigh the cons.
Auntie Zhang is one of many old people who live alone.
Her partner passed away over 10 years ago, and 69-year-old Auntie Zhang’s children work in a different city.
Her retirement pension is decent, and she does not have to worry about having food on the table.
But, as she gets older, she is getting more and more lonely.
Her children are busy with work and can’t return home more than a few times per year.
Auntie Zhang hopes she can find another partner.
This way, if either of them has any minor illness, they can take care of each other.
Recently, someone introduced an old man, Uncle Liu, to Auntie Zhang.
Uncle Liu is 71 years old. His wife passed away three years ago, and his children are all overseas.
He is in good health and likes to travel, sing, and exercise.
Auntie Zhang has met with Uncle Liu a few times and thinks that he is a very nice person.
But, she was afraid that her children would object and did not know how to bring this up with them.
Her old friend Auntie Wang came up with an idea.
The idea was for her to take advantage of the May Day holiday when the children would be home, ..
.. ask Uncle Liu to dinner with them, and see how the children react.
The May Day holiday soon came, and the children all came home.
Auntie Zhang specially cooked a whole table of dishes just for this occasion.
Her son and daughter were very surprised upon seeing this.
Her daughter said, “Mom, this is the first time you’ve cooked this much delicious food.
When my older brother and I used to come home, you certainly didn’t cook this many dishes. Is something going on?”
Auntie Zhang said, “I have an old friend who has been wanting to taste my cooking.
Now that you all are back, I wanted to invite him over for dinner.”
When her daughter heard this, she looked over at her older brother and said, “Let me guess, it’s a man?”
Just as they were speaking, the doorbell rang.
Auntie Zhang opened the door and introduced Uncle Liu to the children. Then, they started eating.
At the dinner table, Uncle Liu and the children had a great time chatting.
Despite Uncle Liu’s age, he is very fond of new things and has a lot of things in common with young people.
Auntie Zhang’s daughter said to her, “Mom, this friend of yours is great. I like him.”
After hearing her daughter say this, half of Auntie Zhang’s worries were gone.
She earnestly said to her children, “Son, Daughter, if I told you I wanted to marry Uncle Liu, would you agree to this?”
The children heard Auntie Zhang’s words and were quiet for a few minutes.
Then, her daughter said, “I need to discuss this with my older brother.”
After speaking, she pulled her older brother into the bedroom.
This time while the children were away was the most nervous time for Auntie Zhang and Uncle Liu.
After around 10 minutes, the children came out, walked over to Auntie Zhang’s side, and said, ..
.. “Mom, Uncle Liu, we agree. Uncle Liu is a good person.
We are busy with work and cannot come home often, so if you have Uncle Liu taking care of you, that would put us at ease.”
Then, they walked to Uncle Liu’s side and said, ..
.. ”Uncle Liu, my mom has a retirement pension and health insurance, and we are both working and earning money.
She won’t be a burden. I heard my mom say that your children are all overseas.
So, in the future, after you and my mom get married, we will be your son and daughter.
We will take care of you just like we take care of our mom. But, you must be good to our mom!”
After hearing the children’s words, Auntie Zhang and Uncle Liu laughed out loud.
Uncle Liu said, “Don’t worry, children, your mom and I will be happy.
It’s not easy to find a suitable partner in old age. I will cherish this.”
